content: All four official-league strategies remain offline following mid-June failures. Both Timmy variants run clean v3 historical tapes but have been dark for over a week, leaving their low-win-rate / high-right-tail profiles unvalidated against current conditions. League-wide live trust is zero pending restart and reconciliation.
